source_notes.wdi_gdp: World Bank WDI API, indicator NY.GDP.MKTP.CD, annual current USD for the 20-country legacy backtest surface.
source_notes.wdi_population: World Bank WDI API, indicator SP.POP.TOTL, used for 2015 initial-state alignment.
source_notes.wdi_fx_reserves: World Bank WDI API, indicator FI.RES.XGLD.CD, used for 2015 initial-state alignment.
source_notes.wdi_public_debt: World Bank WDI API, indicator GC.DOD.TOTL.GD.ZS, used for 2015 initial-state alignment.
source_notes.wdi_country_co2: World Bank WDI API, indicator EN.GHG.CO2.MT.CE.AR5, used for 2015 initial-state alignment.
source_notes.gcp_global_co2: Global Carbon Budget 2024 workbook, sheet 'Global Carbon Budget', column 'fossil emissions excluding carbonation', converted from GtC/yr to GtCO2/yr.
source_notes.hadcrut5_temperature: HadCRUT.5.1.0.0 annual global summary series from the Met Office, rebased to an 1850-1900 mean so the anomaly matches the model's preindustrial framing.
source_notes.noaa_atmospheric_co2: NOAA GML global annual mean atmospheric CO2 concentration, used to seed the 2015 atmospheric stock before the simulation starts.
